properties.title: CrossScope: A Role-Asymmetric World Model for Joint Dual-Scope Surgical Video Prediction

membership.reason: Dual-stream surgical video world model (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT experts + frozen VAE) jointly forecasting 8 future frames of Mother and Child ERCP scopes from observed anchors and causal history.

properties.backbone: Dual-stream Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT experts (rank-128 LoRA) + shared frozen VAE + M2C Pose Readout + C2M geometry-gated appearance translation

properties.flow: Mother & Child anchor frames + causal Child history cache H_C + prompt c -> Dual DiT experts with M2C & C2M residual routing -> Frozen VAE decoder -> 8-frame dual-scope video forecast

properties.purpose: Short-horizon joint dual-scope surgical video prediction in Mother-Child ERCP.
properties.environment: Phantom and retrospective single-cohort clinical ERCP videos

assertions.rationale: Episode-disjoint splits; patient- and case-level separation in real-world ERCP; strictly causal history cache (>=33 points before anchor).
Shared frozen video VAE encodes Mother and Child frames into latent groups.
Adapts Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiT via rank-128 LoRA and reuses shared frozen VAE.
Role-asymmetric directional M2C (motion) and C2M (geometry-gated appearance) residual routing between Mother and Child experts.
Latent frame groups z^0, z^1 (frames 1-4), z^2 (frames 5-8) plus causal Child history cache H_C.
Conditions on anchor frames and up to two geometry-selected causal Child history observations H_C.
Maintains causal Child history cache H_C with cached poses and ages.
Forecasts from observed video anchors, causal history, and fixed phase text prompt; no settable scope-actuation action inputs.
Forecasts 8 future synchronized video frames (stride 4) after observed anchors.
Frozen VAE decoder reconstructs predicted Mother and Child RGB video frames.
Evaluates 8-frame future video prediction (PSNR, SSIM, FID, LPIPS) on phantom (860 windows) and real-world (7 episodes) test sets.
Jointly predicts 8 future frames (frames 1-4 and 5-8) after anchor.
8-frame future horizon at stride 4 (33 synchronized points).
No planner or controller coupled to CrossScope.
Short-horizon dual-scope surgical video prediction in Mother-Child ERCP.
Retrospective real-world study conducted under ethics approval with waiver of informed consent; videos de-identified.

evidence_fragments.content: This design allows each scope to contribute task-relevant evidence without compromising its view-specific representation. To evaluate this problem, we establish a paired dual-scope benchmark comprising synchronized phantom and real-world ERCP episodes, with evaluations assessing visual fidelity, structural preservation, target localization, and motion consistency.

The phantom subset contains 300 paired episodes with 596,190 synchronized time points, including 285 training episodes and 15 test episodes. The real-world subset contains 52 paired episodes with 34,800 synchronized time points, split into 45 training and seven held-out test episodes. All splits are episode-disjoint, and the real-world evaluation further ensures patient- and case-level separation between training and testing.

Figure 3: CrossScope architecture. Separate DiT experts expose read-only pre-injection states. Frame 0 is the observed anchor, and future latent groups cover frames 1–4 and 5–8. Pose Readout maps Mother states to a Mother-plane trajectory, which M2C converts into Child motion residuals. C2M pose-aligns Current and up to two causal History observations, then writes or blends Mother residuals only under geometric support.

All systems use rank-128 LoRA (Hu et al. 2022) for 10,000 steps on the same split. CrossScope assigns full- and half-width 30-layer Wan2.2-TI2V-5B DiTs to Child and Mother, respectively, initializing the Mother by interpolation; the experts use separate adapters and a shared frozen VAE. Each window subsamples 33 synchronized points at stride four into one anchor and eight targets. Phantom tests use 860 causal windows from 15 episodes; real-world evaluation uses a patient- and case-disjoint 45/7 split within one cohort.

CrossScope on 45 real episodes and evaluate seven patient- and case-disjoint episodes from the same cohort. Across the role-specific measures in Figure 6, Mother PSNR increases by 1.57 dB, while endpoint and centerline errors decrease by 16.5% and 21.5%. Consistent gains across both roles match the phantom pattern.
CrossScope: A Role-Asymmetric World Model for Joint Dual-Scope Surgical Video Prediction
The retrospective real-world study was conducted under ethics approval with a waiver of informed consent, and all videos were de-identified.

evidence_fragments.content: Given synchronized wide-view Mother and near-field Child videos, we predict eight frames after their observed anchors. Let I0:8d be a nine-frame clip for d∈ {M, C}, c a fixed prompt, and H C ={(I C,j,ˆpj, aj)} a same-episode causal cache of Child observations whose times precede the anchor by at least 33 synchronized time points, with cached predicted Mother-plane poses and ages.

capability_assessments.rationale: Dual-stream surgical video world model forecasting 8 future Mother and Child ERCP frames from observed anchors and causal history without settable control actions.

limitations: Limited to short-horizon (8-frame) prediction in one dual-scope procedure (ERCP) and one clinical cohort.
Real-world data restricted to controlled access.
